# Yoga Farm 3217

> Yoga Farm is a 32-acre wellbeing destination in Mount Duneed, on Victoria's Surf Coast near Geelong and Torquay, Australia. Anna Rimmer is the owner and sole yoga teacher. The property offers yin yoga classes, equine-assisted therapy, wellness retreats, workshops, and independent practitioner services (naturopathy, osteopathy, psychotherapy, energy healing, psychology, women's health massage). Bookings are casual drop-in only — the property's farm zoning prohibits membership or subscription models.

## About
- Location: 150 McCanns Road, Mount Duneed VIC 3217, Australia — Surf Coast, between Geelong and Torquay
- Contact: yogafarm3217@gmail.com
- [Homepage](https://yogafarm.com.au/): overview, About, all four offering areas, testimonials, contact/enquiry form
- [All Offerings](https://yogafarm.com.au/offerings.html): full flat list of every class, therapy session, and retreat with pricing

## Equine-Assisted Therapy — "Healing with Horses"
- [Healing with Horses](https://yogafarm.com.au/healing-with-horses.html): why equine therapy works, all offerings, FAQ
- Equine Assisted Therapy — $150, 60 minutes, one-on-one
- Equine Assisted Reiki + Somatic Healing — $250, 75 minutes, one-on-one
- Equine Assisted Therapy + Yin Yoga — $300, 2¼ hours, one-on-one
- Includes an NDIS-related funded stream

## Yin Yoga, Meditation & Events
- [Yoga & Events](https://yogafarm.com.au/yoga-events.html): Yin Yoga & Meditation classes, Monthly Fire Horse Sessions, Seasonal Healing Sounds with Yin
- Private Yin Yoga with Reiki — $200, 90 minutes, one-on-one

## Retreats
- [Retreats overview](https://yogafarm.com.au/retreats.html)
- [Sacred Soil. Sacred Soul.](https://yogafarm.com.au/retreat-october.html): 2-night women's glamping retreat, October 16–18, 2026. Early Bird $1,850, $500 deposit secures a spot. Includes glamping, private-chef plant-based meals, yin yoga, equine meditations, energy/sound healing, and more
- [Corporate Retreats](https://yogafarm.com.au/corporate-retreats.html): private group and corporate wellness retreats, full-day/half-day/overnight, groups up to 14
